nodes.title: Experimental
widgets_values:
# Combine a VLM with RefMod or image only

**Refmods are video encoded .safetensors they can not be read directly without decoding with a VLM**

Read [MiniMax H3: Omnichar vs. RefMod](https://comfyui.rozenlaan.site/ComfyUI_MiniMax/#minimax-h3-omnichar-vs-refmod) your need more information

## Method 1

- Upload or create a Refmod named Lena.
- Switch "QWEN H3 Prompt (Local)" option "H3 model mode" to "Refmod" (no image input but ref2va Skill).
- Start your prompt with  "Lena is a woman in a red dress" when your Refmod contains this women in a red dress.

## Method 2

- Upload or create a Refmod named Lena.
- Use a reference image of Lena (women in red dress).
- Switch "QWEN H3 Prompt (Local)" option "H3 model mode" to "Ref2VA" (image input and ref2va Skill).
- Start your prompt with "Discribe Lena as seen in picture 1.".

## Method 3
- Upload images only
- Reference the images in your prompt
- Switch "QWEN H3 Prompt (Local)" option "H3 model mode" to "Ref2VA" (image input and ref2va Skill).
